# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a handsome young lady with a plump, showy figure, large bright-blue eyes, and a brilliant complexion with snap and color. She possessed long, beautiful golden hair worn in braids. Near the end of her life, she became very thin, her eyes appeared too bright and lustrous, and her cheeks bore a hectically brilliant color.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v4 c12 P15](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0015)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, good-tempered, and laughed a great deal, frankly enjoying the pleasant things of life. She had a tendency to be nervous and hysterical when startled or frightened. Throughout her life, she was extremely conscious of boys and obsessed with suitors and romantic attention.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c28 P36](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0036), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley and her friends. As a student, she climbed a willow tree on a dare, took part in school entertainments, and passed the Entrance examinations to Queen's Academy. After graduating from Queen's with her teaching license, she taught at a school up west before taking over the Carmody school. Later, she was rumored to be engaged to a Spencervale schoolmaster, whom she turned down. She contracted galloping consumption, forcing her to stop teaching during the winter, though she still hoped to teach at White Sands. During her illness, she reconciled an old school quarrel with Em White and spent a quiet final evening conversing with Anne Shirley. She died peacefully in her sleep shortly thereafter.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c8 P3](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0003), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
